name: rust-crate-fqn-stability
body: Rust module FQNs are stable: a Rust package with a single local crate target, a lib-only package, or a bin-only package renders its module FQNs as the cargo package name; only a package with multiple crate targets carries per-target prefixes. A package's resolvable module and symbol FQNs are preserved; renaming a resolvable FQN is a violation.
